data.name: Entry.Title.Version212
data.value: Quartz job hosting and dashboard hardening

data.name: Entry.Description.Version212
data.value: This patch moves scheduled collectors into a persistent Quartz host, improves snapshot discovery, and tightens the live Currency Strength dashboard experience.

data.name: Entry.Version212.Highlight.1
data.value: Added persistent Quartz job storage, status handling, and execution logging in a dedicated BackgroundJobs host.

data.name: Entry.Version212.Highlight.2
data.value: Moved both Currency Strength and COT collectors into the Quartz host so scheduled data collection runs from one service.

data.name: Entry.Version212.Highlight.3
data.value: Fixed API discovery for Swagger endpoints and report snapshots so data sources are found more reliably.

data.name: Entry.Version212.Highlight.4
data.value: Hardened latest snapshot reads in Currency Strength and removed chart zoom controls for a cleaner dashboard flow.

data.name: Entry.Version212.Highlight.5
data.value: Added a live UTC clock to the dashboard so current market timing is easier to read.

data.name: Entry.Title.Version210
data.value: Currency strength and keyboard navigation

data.name: Entry.Description.Version210
data.value: This release adds currency strength visibility and smoother COT navigation with keyboard support.

data.name: Entry.Version210.Highlight.1
data.value: Added Currency Strength so users can track the power of currencies inside the dashboard.

data.name: Entry.Version210.Highlight.2
data.value: Added left and right arrow key support to the COT experience for faster browsing.

data.name: Entry.Version210.Highlight.3
data.value: Surfaced the running Blazor app version in the footer for quicker release visibility.

data.name: Entry.Title.Version211
data.value: TerminalPrime rollout and release polish

data.name: Entry.Description.Version211
data.value: This patch packages the post-2.1.0 web refresh work into a cleaner branded experience with stronger localization, deployment readiness, and a faster COT workflow.

data.name: Entry.Version211.Highlight.1
data.value: Rebranded the public Blazor experience to TerminalPrime and refreshed home, COT, and Currency Strength SEO content.

data.name: Entry.Version211.Highlight.2
data.value: Updated GitLab CI and production settings so Currency Strength deployment is ready in the release pipeline.

data.name: Entry.Version211.Highlight.3
data.value: Extracted a reusable TopMenu module and cleaned up shared localization resources across the main navigation flow.

data.name: Entry.Version211.Highlight.4
data.value: Localized the landing page content and added dedicated Persian fonts for a more polished Persian web experience.

data.name: Entry.Version211.Highlight.5
data.value: Added a direct COT Legacy toggle so users can switch report mode faster from the COT report page.
